results.title: Baidu Releases ERNIE 5.5 Flash Base: A 280B MoE Base Model With 14B Active Parameters - MarkTechPost
results.description: Weights are on Hugging Face and ModelScope, in FP8 and BF16. Baidu documents serving with SGLang and vLLM. The SGLang example uses --tp 4. The vLLM path needs version 0.32.0 plus the vLLM-ERNIE plugin. Both servers accept up to 1,048,576 tokens.

results.title: ERNIE-5.5-Flash-Base: 280B Params, Just 14B Active [2026]
results.description: It is a 280B-parameter sparse Mixture-of-Experts language model that activates 14B parameters per token. The weights are the checkpoint from the end of pre-training, which means they sit before any mid-training or post-training.
